h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Durg

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Durg

items.pText: Durg and Bhilai have grown into one urban area, with the steel township's sectors on one side and Durg's older town and newer colonies on the other. Schools, housing societies and parks across both ask us for outdoor play equipment. FunPlay Systems designs and makes it at our factory in Vasai, about 900 km away, and sends it to Chhattisgarh by road.

Central Chhattisgarh has very hot summers followed by a strong monsoon, so equipment here must handle dry heat and then steady rain. We build with galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts, and back them with a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. To get started, tell us the size of your ground and the classes or age groups who will use it. A few photos of the ground help us suggest equipment that fits the space you actually have.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Picking the right surface for a Durg play area

c: The surface under the equipment matters as much as the equipment itself. Bare earth turns hard in May and muddy in July, and neither is kind to a child who falls. Rubber flooring gives an even, cushioned base through the year and is simple to sweep. We supply it along with the play equipment, so both arrive and go in together. If budget is tight, cover the fall zones under slides, swings and climbers first and extend the flooring later.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 900 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply both Durg and Bhilai?
items.a: Yes. We deliver to sites across Durg, Bhilai and the rest of Chhattisgarh by road from our Vasai factory, and install through our team or a local dealer.

items.q: Can we lay rubber flooring only in some areas?
items.a: Yes. Many buyers start with the fall zones under each piece and extend the flooring later. We mark these zones on the layout drawing so you know where to begin.

items.q: Which equipment suits a large school in Durg?
items.a: Usually a multi play system for the middle years, swings and see-saws for the youngest and climbers for older children. We suggest the mix based on how many children use the ground at once.
